corpus.anchor_note: The embedded baseline (fts nDCG@10 0.8143) is NOT quoted: its own notes mark that column an embedded-environment artifact (FTS populated 40/100 queries) and name Docker FalkorDB >= 4.x authoritative, which is where this baseline is measured.

question_class_evidence.reading: The question class adds only out-of-vocabulary scaffolding, and no candidate prices an unmatched query term, so its per-arm numbers duplicate the keyword class. It is reported for completeness and must NOT be read as independent evidence either way.

worked_examples.reading: The in-graph scorer ranks a document matching FEWER query terms above one matching ALL of them, because the rare-term weight dominates coverage. That is a scoring property, not a harness artifact: both documents are live and unfiltered.
